scope: Logical compatibility with three reviewed occurrences; no probabilities, statistical test or fitted model
observations: HT7b qi-tu-ne is followed by numeral 1, on the reverse of a tablet with VIR on its front.
HT87 qi-tu-ne precedes ma-ka-ri-te in the heading of a six-entry list.
HT117b qi-tu-ne precedes ku-re-ju 1 and di-ki-se 1; di-ki-se also occurs on HT87.

rivals.hypothesis: Personal name with responsibility for a listed group
rivals.example_assignment: Hypothetically, Qi-tu-ne is counted once on HT7b and heads lists of people under that person's responsibility on HT87/117.
rivals.needed_discriminator: Independent person-name evidence or a known-language control establishing a person-specific construction

rivals.example_assignment: Hypothetically, an occupational class contributes one unit on HT7b and labels members listed on HT87/117.
unverified_assumptions: The single count denotes one member or one group
The header lists members of that class
rivals.needed_discriminator: Source-supported contrasts between named participants and repeated categories in equivalent accounts

rivals.example_assignment: Hypothetically, a place or institution contributes one counted unit on HT7b and identifies the affiliation of HT87/117 entries.
unverified_assumptions: The word denotes a place or institution
The numeral records a contribution rather than counting the referent itself
rivals.needed_discriminator: Independent geographical or institutional identification, not spelling similarity alone

rivals.example_assignment: Hypothetically, a household label or a person's name organizes relatives. This produces the same observed positions as non-family grouping.
unverified_assumptions: Relation direction or gender is recoverable
rivals.needed_discriminator: An independent parent-child or unnamed-relative substitution contrast against ownership, occupation and ordinary grouping negatives

rivals.hypothesis: Exclusive unnumbered-heading use in these three records
rivals.example_assignment: Every qi-tu-ne occurrence is an unnumbered list heading.
rivals.contradiction: HT7b .1 explicitly places numeral 1 after qi-tu-ne.
rivals.limit: This rejects only the narrow positional claim, not every administrative-function interpretation. A numbered heading remains logically possible.

decision: The heading/count contrast is source-supported. Person versus category, affiliation or family grouping remains underdetermined. No semantic or gender label is promoted to gold.
next_dependency: A known-language control that distinguishes names from categories when both can occupy headings and counted entries; additional unlabelled Linear A recurrences alone do not solve this ambiguity.
